\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 174-176 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:UR-R179-first-pass-words-from-chapters-174-176}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a minister and a king.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item maize, wheat, chickpeas, kidney beans, a fig
  \item rasmalai, falooda, kulfi, a quail, a dove
  \item a job, a profession, a salary, a rupee, a coin
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Maize? (\textbf{\ur{مکئی}}, \emph{makaī}.) Wheat? (\textbf{\ur{گندم}}, \emph{gandum}.) Chickpeas? (\textbf{\ur{چنے}}, \emph{chane}.) Kidney beans? (\textbf{\ur{راجما}}, \emph{rājmā}.) A fig? (\textbf{\ur{انجیر}}, \emph{anjīr}.) Rasmalai? (\textbf{\ur{رس} \ur{ملائی}}, \emph{ras malāī}.) Falooda? (\textbf{\ur{فالودہ}}, \emph{fālūdā}.) Kulfi? (\textbf{\ur{قلفی}}, \emph{qulfī}.) A quail? (\textbf{\ur{بٹیر}}, \emph{baṭer}.) A dove? (\textbf{\ur{فاختہ}}, \emph{fākhtā}.) A job? (\textbf{\ur{نوکری}}, \emph{naukrī}.) A profession? (\textbf{\ur{پیشہ}}, \emph{peshā}.) A salary? (\textbf{\ur{تنخواہ}}, \emph{tankhvāh}.) A rupee? (\textbf{\ur{روپیہ}}, \emph{rupayā}.) A coin? (\textbf{\ur{سکہ}}, \emph{sikkā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 177-179 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:UR-R179-second-pass-words-from-chapters-177-179}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for an employee and a colleague.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item an employee, a colleague, a labourer, a farmer, a tailor
  \item a singer, a pilot, a sailor, a fisherman, a gardener
  \item a midwife, a treasurer, a clerk, a minister, a king
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
An employee? (\textbf{\ur{ملازم}}, \emph{mulāzim}.) A colleague? (\textbf{\ur{ساتھی}}, \emph{sāthī}.) A labourer? (\textbf{\ur{مزدور}}, \emph{mazdūr}.) A farmer? (\textbf{\ur{کسان}}, \emph{kisān}.) A tailor? (\textbf{\ur{درزی}}, \emph{darzī}.) A singer? (\textbf{\ur{گلوکار}}, \emph{gulūkār}.) A pilot? (\textbf{\ur{پائلٹ}}, \emph{pāilaṭ}.) A sailor? (\textbf{\ur{ملاح}}, \emph{mallāh}.) A fisherman? (\textbf{\ur{مچھیرا}}, \emph{machherā}.) A gardener? (\textbf{\ur{مالی}}, \emph{mālī}.) A midwife? (\textbf{\ur{دائی}}, \emph{dāī}.) A treasurer? (\textbf{\ur{خزانچی}}, \emph{khazānchī}.) A clerk? (\textbf{\ur{منشی}}, \emph{munshī}.) A minister? (\textbf{\ur{وزیر}}, \emph{vazīr}.) A king? (\textbf{\ur{بادشاہ}}, \emph{bādshāh}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
